intended_use.primary_uses: Academic performance prediction, early intervention advisement, and study pattern clustering.
intended_use.intended_users: Course instructors, academic advisors, educational researchers.
intended_use.out_of_scope_uses: Automated punitive grading, admissions rejection, high-stakes disciplinary decisions without human oversight.

factors_and_data.dataset_nature: Synthetic educational data generated with fixed random seeds for academic rigor.

ethical_considerations.privacy: Zero personal identifiable information (PII). All records are synthetically constructed.
ethical_considerations.fairness_warning: Fairness parity metrics on synthetic groups cannot guarantee parity on diverse real-world demographics.
ethical_considerations.human_in_the_loop: Predictions must serve as diagnostic suggestions for advisors, never autonomous grading.

caveats_and_limitations.linear_assumptions: Linear models cannot capture extreme non-linear burnout dynamics.
caveats_and_limitations.domain_shift: Performance models trained on typical semesters fail during abrupt schedule shifts without retraining.
